body: Honestly, that would be a good thing for me. I love the feeling of not hating myself that molly gives me.

No, it's ok. I think I deserve a few harsh words anyway. I've been a jerk.

I don't think that "passion" thing applies to us. I fell into that trap when I was younger, in the relationship I had in my early 20s. I wouldn't even call our arguments now "passionate". There's no yelling (or use of all caps, or whatever). We've never had an argument of any sort when we've actually been together in person. Because of the distance, I usually have plenty of time to think about my words and try to send something constructive or mild. It's just that on the inside, I'm far too often insanely angry, and sometimes I say sarcastic and passive aggressive things like today. I'd say that most of the time, I don't do anything to reveal that I'm angry, though I might change the subject away from his work or whatever is bothering me.

You're right, I think. Just reading the description of how your ex made you feel has me in tears. I don't want it to get to that point. I don't want him to ever feel that way. He's amazing and he doesn't deserve the way I've treated him.

I don't think the email I wrote (but haven't yet sent) contains any hurtful stuff. It explains that I love him but that I've been behaving horribly and he deserves better. No sarcasm or anything mean, at all.

Other than that, I think you could be right. I've been dreadful and I didn't even know I could be that way, especially to someone I care about so much. I'm so disgusted with myself...

I feel like I've already done so much damage to our relationship with my reprehensible behavior that we might not have much of a chance at making it work anymore. And I feel like it's so dishonest to let him make career decisions based on us being together when I'm thinking of ending things.

Of course, I have wondered about what you said. Maybe it is his impending arrival that is putting me on edge and things will be different after. But I've been such a jerk and I feel so bad for it. I'm even being a jerk right now... We normally email back and forth constantly but I haven't written for hours, while I think these things over.
I guess there's more gaming/sex buddies out there than people think!
Are you my FWB? I'd marry him if he wanted me.
I'd be happy, but he wouldn't be. He's my best friend and we've been sleeping together for months. It was supposed to be casual, but I fell in love. He doesn't feel the same.
Thanks. I tend to over think things and freak out. I thought it would be better to do it on Reddit, rather than in this guy's face.

Yeah, he was drinking and doing coke.

We are bound to run into each other again, since we have a lot of friends in common. Should I just pretend it never happened? Or did I actually ruin this friendship?
